Uses of Class
org.clafer.ir.IrIntVar

Packages that use IrIntVar
Package
Description
org.clafer.ast.compiler
This package provides a compiler to translate Clafer AST to IR.
org.clafer.ir
This package provides the IR used as in intermediate language during compilation.
org.clafer.ir.analysis.deduction
This package provides the deductions of the IR optimizer: feasibility-based bounds tightening (FBBT), with one deducer per kind of IR constraint, which narrows the domains of the variables before the IR is compiled to Choco, removes constraints that hold, and coalesces variables that must be equal.
org.clafer.ir.compiler
This package provides a compiler to translate IR to Choco.
